name: Kernel Developer
description: Write bare-metal OS components: bootloaders, interrupt handlers, memory managers, schedulers, and system calls. Build a minimal kernel from scratch.
example_snippet:
program KernelMain:
    unsafe:
        # VGA text buffer at 0xB8000
        keep VGA as * volatile byte
        put transmute 753664 as * volatile byte into VGA

        # Print 'K' in white on black
        put 75 into Index at 0 of VGA
        put 15 into Index at 1 of VGA
    end unsafe

    # Halt
    repeat forever:
    end repeat
end program
